checks.name: persistent_state_graph
checks.evidence: Every NodeSpec binds each owned field to one ArtifactKind; StateGraph rejects a wrong kind both at transition time and when reading a persisted state. B1 now owns ExecutionDesignDraft, while ASSEMBLE_B0 owns BlockingCommit.

checks.name: checkpoint_resume
checks.evidence: Kill-point recovery covers E0, S1, B0, and B1 with canonical payloads, and checks checkpoint dependency digests rather than paths. Prepared recovery recomputes the graph transition before promotion.

checks.name: pending_write_atomicity
checks.evidence: A prepared event stays invisible until its atomic commit exists. Recovery validates the prepared next state and its deterministic transition against the current accepted state before promotion.

checks.name: content_addressed_artifacts
checks.evidence: ArtifactRepository now recomputes the canonical content hash of a stored envelope before accepting an ArtifactRef; a post-hash payload mutation is rejected and cannot enter NodeRunner.

checks.name: field_level_invalidation
checks.evidence: Digest-edge invalidation remains graph-declared and preserves unrelated accepted nodes; its graph now has an explicit, persistent field-to-kind contract.

review.finding: The prior A2 fixture used generic SCRIPT_FACT envelopes for multiple semantic fields and modeled B1 as BlockingCommit. StateGraph also had no field-to-ArtifactKind authority, and a mutated on-disk artifact could still satisfy ArtifactRepository.contains().
review.root_cause: The former graph encoded field ownership without output type ownership, while loading persistent state trusted self-consistent JSON without validating it against the graph declaration.

considered_options.option: Relax A1 payload authority so the old generic fixture passes
considered_options.reason: It would restore the escape hatch that A1 was specifically repaired to close.

considered_options.option: Put kind checking only in NodeRunner
considered_options.reason: Checkpoints and state events must fail closed after restart as well as on the live write path.

considered_options.option: Bind NodeSpec fields to ArtifactKind and validate every state load, recovery, and repository reference
considered_options.reason: It freezes the A2 state/recovery port while preserving the A1 canonical domain authority.

review.residual_risk: A2 supplies the durable typed graph boundary only. Later packages remain responsible for Director creative orchestration, Gate 0/DP behavior, projection, media evidence, and user approval. No external model, media, Shadow, approval, or production switch was started.

informational_results.name: compile_and_patch_check
informational_results.result: Compiled without error and no whitespace errors found.
